description:
Identify all country polygons that are intersected by the Equator (0° Latitude) and export them to a new shapefile.

Starting state: gvSIG Desktop is open with the 'countries_base' project loaded. The Natural Earth countries layer (ne_110m_admin_0_countries) is visible.

Your task:
1. Determine which countries are crossed by the Equator (Latitude 0). You may use selection tools, coordinate readouts, or spatial queries.
2. Select ONLY those countries.
3. Export the selected features to a new shapefile at: /home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/equatorial_countries.shp

The output shapefile must contain only the countries that the equator passes through (e.g., Brazil, Indonesia, etc.).
